hints.tr: `let undo = Undo { list, keep };`, sonra öğeleri `undo.list`'e ekle.
hints.en: `let undo = Undo { list, keep };`, then add items to `undo.list`.

tests.code: let mut l = vec![String::from("a")]; assert!(add_all(&mut l, &["b", "c"]).is_ok()); assert_eq!(l, ["a", "b", "c"]);
let mut l = vec![String::from("a")]; assert_eq!(add_all(&mut l, &["b", ""]), Err(String::from("empty item"))); assert_eq!(l, ["a"]);
